score_range_label.en: Moderate Bullish (62.0) — Trend up, breadth repairing, technical overbought warning
score_range_label.zh: 中性偏多 (62.0) — 趋势向上，广度修复，技术超买预警

position_advice.en: 60-65% (Shift structure from AI leaders to Healthcare/Industrials/Financials. 30%+ cash waiting for PCE. Don't chase, don't short, wait for signal)
position_advice.zh: 60-65%（结构从AI龙头转向Healthcare/工业/金融。30%+现金等PCE结果。不追高，不做空，等信号）

condition.en: Expanding but structural turning point forming
condition.zh: 扩张但结构性拐点正在形成

summary.en: Liquidity is expanding but a structural turning point is forming. Net liquidity +$42-55B WoW, up +$230B from the April bottom. TGA continues to release (-$57.3B WoW). However, Warsh's QT is ongoing (-$14.9B WoW) and ON RRP is essentially zero, leaving the system with no shock absorbers. The turning point is expected within 6-8 weeks.
summary.zh: 流动性正在扩张但结构性拐点正在形成。净流动性周环比 +$42-55B，从 4 月底部回升 +$230B。TGA 持续释放（周环比 -$57.3B）。然而，Warsh 缩表持续（周环比 -$14.9B），且 ON RRP 基本归零，系统已无减震器。预计转折点将在 6-8 周内到来。

fed_balance_sheet_change.zh: -149 亿美元（周环比）——Warsh 缩表持续

rrp_note.en: Essentially zero — no shock absorber remaining
rrp_note.zh: 基本归零——系统已无减震器

net_liquidity_change.zh: 周环比 +$42-55B——从 4 月底部回升 +$230B

details.en: The liquidity engine is still running but losing power. TGA release provides a temporary tailwind, but Warsh's QT has started and ON RRP is exhausted. With no buffers left, the next liquidity shock will transmit directly to asset prices. June FOMC (6/17-18) will be the critical event to determine the full QT path.
details.zh: 流动性引擎仍在运转但正在失去动力。TGA 释放提供暂时顺风，但 Warsh 缩表已经启动，ON RRP 已耗尽。没有缓冲的情况下，下一次流动性冲击将直接传导到资产价格。6 月 FOMC（6/17-18）将是确定完整缩表路径的关键事件。

reason.en: Net liquidity +$42-55B/wk, up $230B from bottom. 30Y eased from 5.19% to 5.06%. But Warsh QT -$14.9B/wk ongoing, ON RRP at zero with no buffer.
reason.zh: 净流动性 +$42-55B/周，从底部回升 $230B。30Y 从 5.19% 回落至 5.06%。但 Warsh 缩表 -$14.9B/周持续，ON RRP 归零无缓冲。

reason.en: NVDA 4th consecutive beat-and-sell. WMT -6% confirms consumer pressure. Healthcare +3.4% is the brightest rotation signal outside AI. Technical composite at 88.22 near extreme overbought.
reason.zh: NVDA 连续第 4 次超预期但下跌。WMT -6% 确认消费承压。Healthcare +3.4% 是 AI 以外最亮的轮动信号。技术复合指标 88.22 接近极端超买。

reason.en: 56.37% above 200DMA (up from 53.7%). Russell leading +0.91%, Healthcare +3.4% is the first hard breadth expansion signal. Still below 60% threshold.
reason.zh: 56.37% 在 200 日均线上方（从 53.7% 回升）。Russell 领涨 +0.91%，Healthcare +3.4% 是广度扩散的第一个硬信号。仍低于 60% 门槛。

reason.en: S&P 7,473 is only 0.6% from ATH 7,517. 8-week winning streak. RSI 68 near overbought. MACD sell signal not resolved.
reason.zh: S&P 7,473 距 ATH 7,517 仅 0.6%。连涨 8 周。RSI 68 接近超买。MACD 卖出信号未解除。

trading_summary.en: 62.0 — Moderate Bullish. Liquidity expanding, trend up, breadth repairing — don't short when all three are true. But technical composite at 88.22 says market is at the edge of extreme overbought. Warsh is the biggest medium-term variable — first week QT of $15B is just the beginning. Next week PCE is the binary event: <0.2% opens path to 7,600, >0.3% ends the 8-week streak. Strategy: 60-65% riding the trend, structure shifting from AI leaders to Healthcare/Industrials/Financials, 30%+ cash waiting for PCE. Don't chase, don't short, wait for signal.
trading_summary.zh: 62.0分，Moderate Bullish。流动性在扩张，趋势在向上，广度在修复——三个事实同时成立时不做空。但技术复合88.22告诉我市场在极端超买边缘。Warsh是最大中期变量，第一周缩表$15B只是开始。下周PCE是二元事件：<0.2%打开7,600路径，>0.3%终结8周连涨。策略：60-65%仓位骑趋势，结构从AI龙头转向Healthcare/工业/金融，30%+现金等PCE结果。不追高，不做空，等信号。

trading_quote: Don't short when liquidity, trend and breadth all point up. But 88.22 says we're near the edge.

note.zh: 连涨 8 周，距 ATH 7,517 仅 0.6%

exchange_flow_detail.en: YTD -30%, 52-week range $60,074-$126,198. Small bounce but structural divergence from equity ATH persists.
exchange_flow_detail.zh: YTD -30%，52 周范围 $60,074-$126,198。小幅反弹但与股市 ATH 的结构性背离持续。

analysis.en: BTC at $76,600 (+1.78%), a small bounce but still YTD -30%. The 52-week range ($60K-$126K) shows the magnitude of the drawdown. As a leading indicator, BTC's persistent weakness relative to equity ATH remains an unresolved macro warning.
analysis.zh: BTC 报 $76,600（+1.78%），小幅反弹但仍 YTD -30%。52 周范围（$60K-$126K）显示了回撤的幅度。作为领先指标，BTC 相对于股市 ATH 的持续弱势仍是一个未解决的宏观警告。

analysis.en: Gold at $4,523/oz, slight pullback. Silver at $76.93, Copper +1.35% — industrial metals rising. The structural bull case for gold remains intact given fiscal concerns and geopolitical risks.
analysis.zh: 黄金报 $4,523/盎司，小幅回落。白银 $76.93，铜 +1.35%——工业金属上涨。考虑到财政担忧和地缘政治风险，黄金的结构性牛市逻辑依然完整。

detail.en: Composite technical indicator at 88.22 — historically, readings above 90 correspond to market tops. RSI at 68, MACD sell signal active, 8-week winning streak. Upside is compressed while downside risk is accumulating. Next week's PCE data is the binary event.
detail.zh: 复合技术指标 88.22——历史上，读数超过 90 对应市场顶部。RSI 68，MACD 卖出信号活跃，连涨 8 周。上行空间被压缩而下行风险在积累。下周 PCE 数据是二元事件。

title.en: Warsh structural shift — no shock absorbers left
title.zh: Warsh 结构性转变——减震器已耗尽

detail.en: First week QT at -$14.9B is a declaration, not a test. ON RRP at zero means no shock absorber remains. The next liquidity shock will transmit directly to asset prices. June FOMC will reveal the full QT path.
detail.zh: 第一周缩表 -$14.9B 是宣言不是试探。ON RRP 归零意味着没有减震器了。下一次流动性冲击将直接传导到资产价格。6 月 FOMC 将揭示完整缩表路径。

title.en: Consumer cracks widening — Costco is the next test
title.zh: 消费裂缝扩大——Costco 是下一个验证点

detail.en: WMT -6% is hard evidence of consumer stress. Next week Costco earnings is the validation point. If Costco also misses, the consumer narrative flips from 'resilient' to 'deteriorating'. Healthcare +3.4% rotation suggests smart money is already repositioning defensively.
detail.zh: WMT -6% 是消费者承压的硬证据。下周 Costco 财报是验证点。如果 Costco 也 miss，消费叙事将从'韧性'翻转为'恶化'。Healthcare +3.4% 轮动说明聪明钱已在防御性重新配置。

title.en: Active. BTC -30% YTD vs Equity ATH. NVDA 4th beat-and-sell. Technical composite 88.22 near extreme. WMT -6% vs Equity ATH.
title.zh: 活跃。BTC -30% YTD vs 股市 ATH。NVDA 连续第 4 次超预期下跌。技术复合 88.22 接近极端。WMT -6% vs 股市 ATH。

detail.en: Multiple divergences remain active. BTC at YTD lows while equities are at ATH is a classic leading indicator warning. NVDA's 4th consecutive beat-and-sell confirms AI growth is fully priced. Technical composite at 88.22 signals mean-reversion risk. WMT's consumer stress diverges sharply from the equity ATH narrative.
detail.zh: 多重背离依然活跃。BTC 处于年内低点而股市处于 ATH 是经典的领先指标警告。NVDA 连续第 4 次超预期下跌确认 AI 增长已完全定价。技术复合指标 88.22 发出均值回归风险信号。WMT 的消费者压力与股市 ATH 叙事形成尖锐背离。
